title: Multi-Contact Force Estimation for Continuum Robots via Gaussian-Parameterized Factor Graphs
summary: Continuum robots offer key advantages in navigating unstructured environments, but their safe operation requires accurate estimation of the external contact forces acting anywhere along the robot body. Estimating these forces at unknown locations is an ill-conditioned problem, particularly for multiple contacts. We propose a unified shape and force estimation framework formulated on a factor graph. By incorporating a Gaussian mixture force parameterization into a discretized probabilistic Cosserat rod model, we reduce the dimensionality of the unknown external forces and mitigate the ill-conditioning of node-wise force estimation. The framework fuses strain, tendon tension, and pose measurements to simultaneously estimate the robot's shape and external forces while accounting for modeling and sensor uncertainties. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing methods in terms of force location and magnitude estimation for both single and multi-contact scenarios. We further present a progressive variant that introduces basis functions on demand to estimate contact forces sequentially during a simulated confined-navigation task.
tldr: This paper proposes a unified shape and force estimation framework for continuum robots using Gaussian-parameterized factor graphs, which reduces ill-conditioning in multi-contact force estimation and fuses strain, tendon tension, and pose measurements, outperforming existing methods in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯参数化因子图的连续机器人统一形状与力估计框架，通过减少多点接触力估计中的病态问题，融合应变、肌腱张力和位姿测量，在仿真中优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 连续体机器人在非结构化环境导航中具有关键优势，但其安全运行需要精确估计作用于机器人本体任意位置的外部接触力。在未知位置估计这些力是一个病态问题，尤其是在多接触情况下。我们提出了一种基于因子图构建的统一形状与力估计框架。通过将高斯混合力参数化融入离散化的概率Cosserat杆模型，我们降低了未知外力的维度，并缓解了节点力估计的病态性。该框架融合应变、肌腱张力和位姿测量，在考虑模型与传感器不确定性的同时，同步估计机器人形状和外力。数值仿真表明，在单接触和多接触场景下，所提方法在力的位置和大小估计方面均优于现有方法。我们进一步提出一种渐进变体，该变体按需引入基函数，在模拟受限导航任务中顺序估计接触力。

title: BTI-Net: Bidirectional Decoder-Level Task Interaction via Uncertainty-Aware Gating for Multi-Task Medical Image Analysis
summary: Jointly learning to segment and classify medical images demands cross-task synergy, yet encoder-sharing architectures limit decoder reconstruction to task-private representations, permanently discarding the boundary cues and semantic priors each branch could supply to the other. This work introduces BTI-Net, which establishes bidirectional communication at every decoder level through two parallel pathways via Task Interaction Modules (TIM). Spatial boundary context is gated into the classification branch, while global semantic priors multiplicatively modulate the decoder, with refined features propagating progressively from coarse semantics to fine boundary detail across all four decoder resolutions. Since cross-task interaction is not equally reliable for every input, Uncertainty Proxy Attention (UPA) gates each TIM output per instance and per level using three signals that capture cross-task alignment, scene complexity, and prediction confidence, without external annotations or additional inference passes. Experiments on three medical benchmarks spanning ultrasound, dermoscopy, and brain MRI demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation IoU and classification accuracy over both encoder-sharing and decoder-interaction baselines. Ablation confirms adaptive gating contributes +2.36 IoU over fixed bidirectional interaction, and classification accuracy improves by up to +2.26 points over the strongest multi-task baseline. UPA's uncertainty proxies serve as reliable single-pass task-failure signals without the overhead of stochastic sampling. Code: https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/BTI-Net_MTL
tldr: BTI-Net introduces bidirectional decoder-level task interaction with uncertainty-aware gating for joint segmentation and classification in medical images, achieving improvements across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: BTI-Net 提出了一种具有不确定性感知门控的双向解码器级任务交互方法，用于医学图像的联合分割与分类，在多个基准上取得改进。
summary_zh: 联合学习医学图像分割与分类需要跨任务协同，但编码器共享架构将解码器重建限制为任务私有表示，永久丢弃了各分支可相互提供的边界线索和语义先验。本文提出BTI-Net，该网络通过任务交互模块（TIM）在每条解码器层级建立两条并行路径的双向通信。空间边界上下文被门控注入分类分支，而全局语义先验则通过乘法方式调节解码器，精炼特征从粗粒度语义逐步传播到跨四个解码器分辨率的精细边界细节。由于跨任务交互对每个输入并非同样可靠，不确定性代理注意力（UPA）利用三种信号（捕获跨任务对齐、场景复杂度及预测置信度）对每个实例和每个层级的TIM输出进行门控，无需外部标注或额外推理过程。在超声、皮肤镜和脑部MRI三项医学基准上的实验表明，相较于编码器共享和解码器交互基线，分割IoU和分类精度均持续提升。消融实验证实，自适应门控相较于固定双向交互贡献了+2.36 IoU，分类精度比最强多任务基线提升了多达+2.26个百分点。UPA的不确定性代理可作为可靠的单次任务失败信号，且无需随机采样的开销。代码：https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/BTI-Net_MTL

title: Interventional Flow Matching: Prospective Dose-Response Forecasting with Velocity-Field Jacobian Regularization
summary:
Predicting a patient's physiological trajectory under a planned treatment sequence is a prospective interventional problem, not standard time-series extrapolation. We study this problem in glucose management, where insulin and carbohydrate records are policy-dependent: future drivers are coupled to patient state, behavior, and clinical decision rules, so observational forecasting accuracy alone does not guarantee correct responses to planned interventions.
  We introduce Interventional Flow Matching (IFM), a continuous-time generative framework for physiologically constrained prospective forecasting. IFM conditions a flow-matching velocity field on patient history and planned future drivers in a bounded latent glucose space. Rather than embedding strict mechanistic glucose--insulin ODE equations or enforcing causality through rollout-based simulations, IFM uses a solver-free regularization: it penalizes the Jacobian of the instantaneous velocity field with respect to smoothed treatment drivers. This imposes signed, dose-bounded local sensitivities directly on the learned dynamics: insulin lowers glucose, carbohydrates raise it, and both responses remain within plausible ranges.
  On a simulated UVA/Padova type 1 diabetes cohort, IFM achieves the strongest balance between observed-driver RMSE and interventional response metrics. Across experiments, it consistently produces physiologically correct responses to both insulin and carbohydrate drivers while maintaining high directional, and ranking consistency.
tldr: This paper introduces Interventional Flow Matching (IFM), a continuous-time generative framework that uses velocity-field Jacobian regularization to enforce physiologically correct dose-response relationships for prospective forecasting in glucose management, achieving strong performance on a simulated type 1 diabetes cohort.
tldr_zh: 本文提出介入式流匹配（IFM），一种连续时间生成框架，通过速度场雅可比正则化强制实现生理上正确的剂量-响应关系，用于葡萄糖管理中的前瞻性预测，在模拟的1型糖尿病队列上表现优异。
summary_zh:
预测患者在计划治疗方案下的生理轨迹是一个前瞻性干预问题，而非标准的时间序列外推。我们在血糖管理领域研究该问题，其中胰岛素和碳水化合物记录依赖于治疗策略：未来的驱动因素与患者状态、行为和临床决策规则耦合，因此仅凭借观测预测的准确性并不能保证对计划干预做出正确响应。

我们提出干预流匹配（IFM），一种用于生理约束下前瞻性预测的连续时间生成框架。IFM在有界潜在血糖空间中，基于患者历史信息和计划的未来驱动因素，对流匹配速度场进行条件化。IFM并未嵌入严格的机制性血糖-胰岛素常微分方程，也未通过基于展开的模拟来强制因果关系，而是采用一种无求解器的正则化方法：它惩罚瞬时速度场相对于平滑处理驱动因素的雅可比矩阵。这直接将带符号、剂量有界的局部敏感性施加于学习到的动态过程：胰岛素降低血糖，碳水化合物升高血糖，且两者的响应均保持在合理范围内。

在模拟的UVA/Padova 1型糖尿病队列上，IFM在观测驱动因素的均方根误差与干预响应指标之间实现了最强的平衡。在各项实验中，它始终对胰岛素和碳水化合物驱动因素产生生理学上正确的响应，同时保持了高方向一致性和排序一致性。
